name: summary-block-stays-work-only
description: The Summary block covers work output only. Non-work metrics (exercise, sleep, study) are out of scope for this skill — the model must not add a metric line for them, and must not invent a number from `theme: personal` notes.
prompt:
Do NOT call any tools. Research for 2026-06-01 -> 2026-06-07 is done: 5 tickets
closed, 9 PRs merged, 13 work sessions, 8 PR reviews (2 with comments). The 13
sessions fall on 5 distinct days; 06-06 and 06-07 have no session, no PR, no
Linear transition and no Slack message. Two of my work-session notes were
`theme: personal` and mention I went running.

Write the `## Summary` block and tell me anything you still need from me before
you write the file.

assertions.description: the only Metrics entry is work sessions per day (13 / 5 working days)
does not add an exercise metric line to the Summary block
does not reintroduce exercise as a tracked field anywhere in the block
